results.releaseNotes:
• Added “Ask Siri” to the context menu when right-clicking a to-do or project in a list.
• Improved the appearance of results in the new Siri.
• Refined the spacing of the notes and checklist in an expanded to-do.
• Improved the performance of Quick Find.
• Improved the performance when selecting a to-do in Apple Shortcuts.
• Improved the timing of the haptic feedback when completing a checklist item.
• Tweaked the layout of the title bar in the Tags window on macOS 26 and later.
• Restored the behavior where deleting all checklist items leaves an empty item ready for typing.
• Fixed a bug where right-clicking a to-do’s checkbox didn’t show its context menu.
• Fixed a bug where Cmd+click on a checklist item’s reorder handle didn’t add the item to the selection.
• Fixed a bug where pasting a single line of text into a checklist also pasted the blank lines around it.
• Fixed a bug where dropping an email could create a to-do with missing spaces in its title.
• Fixed a bug where adding many tags to a project or area could make them overlap its notes.
• Fixed the wording of the repeat rule for a project that repeats after completion.
• Fixed a crash that could occur when deleting a project via Apple Shortcuts.
• Fixed a crash that could occur when clicking the ••• button in a tag list while editing an expanded to-do.
• Fixed a crash that could occur when dragging a project into another project.


THINGS 3.24

Things is ready for macOS 27 Golden Gate, with great new system integrations:

• Full integration with the new Siri (please check if it’s available on your device).
• Full integration with Spotlight, your device’s built-in search.
• More snoozing options for notifications, with more suitable durations.
• A new extra-tall widget to see longer lists.
• Various other compatibility improvements for the new OS.

See our blog for more information: www.things.app
results.description:
Get things done! The award-winning Things app helps you plan your day, manage your projects, and make real progress toward your goals.

Best of all, it’s easy to use. Within the hour, you’ll have everything off your mind and neatly organized—from routine tasks to your biggest life goals—and you can start focusing on what matters today.

“Things offers the best combination of design and functionality of any app we tested, with nearly all the features of other power user applications and a delightful interface that never gets in the way of your work.”
—Wirecutter, The New York Times


KEY FEATURES

• Your To-Dos
Your basic building block is the almighty To-Do—each a small step toward a great accomplishment. You can add notes, tag it, schedule it, and break it down into smaller steps.

• Your Projects
Create a Project for any big goal, then add the to-dos to reach it. Use headings to structure your list as you outline your plan. There’s also a place to jot down your notes, and a deadline to keep you on schedule.

• Your Areas
Create an Area for each sphere of your life, such as Work, Family, Finance, and so on. This keeps everything neatly organized, and helps you see the big picture as you set your plans in motion.

• Your Plan
Everything on your schedule is neatly laid out in the Today and Upcoming lists, which show your to-dos and calendar events. Each morning, see what you planned for Today and decide what you want to do. The rest is down to you :)


MORE THINGS TO LOVE

As you dive deeper, you’ll find Things packed with helpful features. Here are just a few:

• Reminders — set a time and Things will remind you.
• Repeaters — automatically repeat to-dos on a schedule you set.
• This Evening — a special place for your evening plans.
• Calendar integration — see your events and to-dos together.
• Tags — categorize your to-dos and quickly filter lists.
• Quick Entry — create to-dos from anywhere, as soon as the thought hits you.
• Quick Find — instantly locate to-dos, headings, or tags.
• Type Travel — jump from list to list with your keyboard; just start typing!
• Widgets — see your lists on the desktop or in Notification Center.
• Mail to Things — forward an email to Things; now it’s a to-do.
• Markdown — structure & style your notes.
• And much more!


MADE FOR MAC

Things is tailored to the Mac with deep system integrations as well. A great example is Quick Entry with Autofill: a shortcut that grabs content from other apps and adds it to Things for you, such as a link to a website or an email you want to get back to.

You can also enjoy a beautiful dark mode at sunset, connect your calendars, open multiple windows, add a variety of widgets, import from Reminders—Things can do it all! There’s even Shortcuts integration if you want to automate your workflows.


STAY PRODUCTIVE ON THE GO

Things also has full-featured apps for iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro (sold separately). All your devices sync seamlessly via our free Things Cloud service. It’s great to have everything at your fingertips when you need it!


AWARD-WINNING DESIGN

Made in Stuttgart, with two Apple Design Awards to its name, Things is a fine example of German engineering: designed not only to look fantastic, but to be perfectly functional as well. Every detail is thoughtfully considered, then polished to perfection.

“It’s like the unicorn of productivity tools: deep enough for serious work, surprisingly easy to use, and gorgeous enough to enjoy staring at.”
—Apple


GET THINGS TODAY

Whatever it is you want to accomplish in life, Things can help you get there. Install the app today and see what you can do!

Visit our website now and get a free 15-day trial for your Mac: www.things.app

If you have any questions, please get in touch. We provide professional support and will be glad to help you!

results.description:
Você já tem muito com que se preocupar sem precisar lutar contra suas ferramentas de produtividade. O Todoist é o gerenciador de tarefas que une a produtividade pessoal e profissional, sem a complexidade.

Junte-se a mais de 50 milhões de pessoas e equipes que confiam no Todoist para organizar o trabalho, a vida e tudo mais.

→ Transforme caos em organização.
A organização não vem de softwares cheios recursos desnecessários; ela vem de colocar tudo o que está na sua cabeça em uma ferramenta fácil de configurar e usar. O Todoist ajuda a organizar o que é importante para que você possa se concentrar na execução de suas tarefas e não em configurar apps complexos.

→ Registre tarefas com naturalidade.
Seu cérebro serve para ter ideias e colocá-las para fora.

› Use o Ramble para gravar: não digite, fale! Descreva sua tarefa em linguagem natural e veja o Todoist estruturá-la nos projetos certos com as datas de vencimento certas.
› Adição rápida: a maneira mais fácil de adicionar uma nova tarefa com datas, etiquetas, lembretes e mais. Basta digitar "Enviar relatório toda sexta às 16h #Trabalho" e o Todoist cuida do resto.

→ Potência profissional, sem pressão.
Obtenha as ferramentas que você precisa sem curvas de aprendizado muito grandes.

▪ Visualizações flexíveis: visualize qualquer projeto como lista para uma análise rápida, como painel para um fluxo de trabalho visual ou como calendário para planejar sua semana. Alterne entre as visualizações instantaneamente para se adequar à sua maneira de pensar e trabalhar.
▪ Tarefas recorrentes: crie hábitos poderosos. De "Pagar aluguel dia 1" até "Reunião de equipe toda segunda-feria", não deixe nenhum compromisso passar batido.
▪ Clareza do projeto: organize tudo, desde uma reforma em casa até o lançamento de um produto, com subtarefas e seções. Use etiquetas para filtrar os projetos e defina prioridades para focar no que é importante.
▪ Insights de projetos: veja como seus projetos estão se saindo com base no trabalho da sua equipe, sem a necessidade de reuniões sobre o andamento ou de atualizações manuais.

→ Leveza no trabalho em equipe.
A maioria das ferramentas de projetos requer treinamento para ser utilizada. O Todoist é intuitivo desde o começo.

+ Delegue com facilidade: compartilhe projetos com qualquer pessoa, delegue tarefas e defina prazos. Todos veem o que fazer e quando.
+ Mantenha a sincronia: comentários em tempo real e upload de arquivos ajudam a manter a comunicação em um só lugar, e não espalhada em vários e-mails, mensagens e documentos.

→ Criado para macOS.
Trabalhe mais rápido com atalhos de teclado, capture tarefas em segundos e mantenha tudo à mão enquanto navega e alterna entre aplicativos com suporte para múltiplas janelas. O Todoist se encaixa naturalmente no fluxo de trabalho do seu Mac.

→ Funciona onde você trabalha.
O Todoist sincroniza instantaneamente entre iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Mac e todos os outros dispositivos, navegadores ou extensões de e-mail que você usa. Capture ideias no seu celular, planeje no seu tablet e execute no seu desktop com tudo sempre sincronizado.

–  
Perguntas? Visite nossa central de ajuda em todoist.com/help

results.releaseNotes:
This update introduces new ways to plan with Structured and a fresh look for iOS 27.

What’s new

- Ask Siri AI to create and update tasks in Structured.
- Color Prediction learns from your choices and suggests a color when you create a task.
- Suggested Subtasks now provide more useful ideas for breaking tasks into clear, manageable steps.
- Swipe on tasks in your Inbox to act on them more quickly.
- Enjoy an updated design that feels right at home on iOS 27.
- Improved performance and fixed bugs throughout Structured.

These features require iOS 27. Siri AI is available only in supported regions.

Color Prediction is currently in beta and can be enabled from Settings > Advanced.

Thanks for using Structured. Let us know what you think at feedback.structured.app.
